meta.title: Send a counter offer from the comparison view

plan.title: Send Auction Counter Offer from Comparison View

steps.note: Open the prepared auction Responses comparison view containing a vendor bid.
Open the buyer's comparison grid where the vendor and counter-offer action are available.
Select the first vendor with a Counter Offer control, open the counter-offer interface, enter revised pricing, and send it.
Verify the comparison view marks the vendor's bid as having a counter offer initiated.
